senses.gloss:
कल् (ङ) कलते 1.
d. To sound; to
enumerate.

कल्ल् (ङ) कल्लते 1.
d. To sound ill or
indistinctly; to be mute.

कल (त् क) कलयति To count. With
आ to take, to bind; with परि to
keep in mind; with वि to cut or
maim; with सं to sum up, to add.

कल (लः) 1.
m. A low or soft tone.
Sāl tree; four mātras.
n. Semen
virile; jujube.
f. A digit 1-16 part
of the moon's diameter; a por-
tion of time; eight seconds; in-
terest; mechanic art; menses;
a boat; fraud.
a. Crude, weak.

काल (क) कालयति 10.
a. To count
time, to reckon.

काल (लः) 1.
m. Time; death;
Shiva;
Saturn; the cuckoo; resin; (ली)
f. Kālī, wife of Shiva; ink; a
worm. (ला) Indigo.
n. Iron.
a.
Black, dark blue.

कालक (कः) 1.
m. A freckle, a mark;
a water-snake.
f. The mother
of the demons.
n. The liver.
a.
Black, dark-coloured.

कल-कण्ठ (ण्ठः) 1.
m. A low murmuring
tone; a cuckoo; a dove; a goose.

काल-कण्ठ (ण्ठः) 1.
m. Shiva; a galli-
nule; sparrow; peacock; tree.

कल-कल (लः) 1.
m. A confused mur-
muring noise; resin, pitch.

कलङ्क (कः) 1.
m. A spot; rust of
iron; defamation, abuse.

कलङ्क-कला (ला) 1.
f. A digit of the
moon in shadow.

कल-ङ्कष (षः) 1.
m. A lion. षा 1.
f. A
musical instrument.

कलञ्ज (ञ्जः) 1.
m. An animal struck
with a poisoned weapon.

कलट (टं) 1.
n. The thatch of a house.

कलन (नं) 1.
n. A spot; a fault;
murmuring; embryo.
m. (नः) A
cane.
f. (ना) subjection; talking;
emitting.

कलम (म) 1.
m. Rice sown in May
and June; a pen; a slip; a thief.

कलम्ब (म्बः) 1.
m. An arrow; stalk
of a potherb. (म्बी) 3.
f. A potherb.

कलम्बिका (का) 1.
f. A potherb; the
nape of the neck.

कल-रव (वः) 1.
m. A dove, pigeon.
cuckoo; a low pleasing tone.

कललजो-द्भव (वः) 1.
m. The Sāl tree
(Shorea robusta).

कलविङ्क (ङ्कः) 1.
m. A sparrow; a
plant; a spot; a white
chauri.

कलशि (शिः) 3.
f. A plant; a water-jar.

कलह (हः-हं) 1.
m. n. War; strife.
m. A sheath, a way; deceit;
violence.

कल-हंस (सः) 1.
m. A drake; a gan-
der; Brahm; a king.

कलह-नाशन (नं) 1.
m. Febrifuge
nut plant.
a. Sedative.

कलहा-न्तरिता (ता) 1.
f. An angry
wife who has become appeased.

कलहा_पहृत (तः-ता-तं)
a. Taken by
force or violence.

कला-कुशल (लः-ला-लं)
a. Skilled in
the elegant arts, as singing, &c.

कला_नुनादिन् (दी) 5.
m. A large
bee; a sparrow; a
Chātaka.

काला_नुनादिन् (दी) 5.
m. A black
bee; a sparrow; a partridge.

कला_प (पः) 1.
m. An ornament; a
string of bells; peacock's tail; a
quiver; a multitude; the moon.

कला_पक (कः) 1.
m. A rope round an
elephant's neck.
n. A series of
four stanzas on one subject; a
cuckoo; a fig tree.

कला_पिन् (पी) 5.
m. A peacock; the
moon; a cypress tree.

कलामक (कः) 1.
m. A kind of rice
ripening in the cold season.

कलाय-खञ्ज (ञ्जः) 1.
m. A man who walks
tremblingly like the wagtail.

कला_यन (नः) 1.
m. A dancer on
the edge of a sword.

कला_वत् (वान्) 5.
m. The moon.
(वती) 3.
f. A celestial lute; mother
of
Rādha; an
apsara; a mystic
ceremony in honour of
Durgā.

कला_हक (कः) 1.
m. A musical in-
strument, sound of one.

कलिका (का) 1.
f. An unblown flow-
er; the bottom or peg of a lute.

कालिक (कः-का-कं)
a. Of times or
seasons; dark. 1.
m. The curlew.
n. A black kind of sandal.
f.
Cloudiness, many clouds; black-
ness;
Durgā; a crow; ink.

कलिका_पूर्ब्ब (र्ब्बं) 1.
n. Acts not aris-
ing from a former birth.

कलिङ्ग (ङ्गः) 1.
m. The febrifuge nut
plant; a forked tailed shrike;
name of a country.
f. (ङ्गा) A
medicinal plant; a fine woman.

कालिङ्ग (गः-गी-गं) 1.
m. An elephant;
a snake. 3.
f. A cucumber. 1.
n.
Watermelon.
a. Of
Kalinga.

कलित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Gained; num-
bered; divided; held; sounded.

कलि-द्रुम (मः) 1.
m. Beleric myro-
balan, the favourite of imps.

कलि-प्रिय (यः) 1.
m. A monkey or
ape;
Nārada. a. Quarrelsome.

कलुक्क (क्कः) 1.
m. A cymbal.
f. (का)
A tavern; a meteor.

कलुष (षं) 1.
n. Sin.
a. Turbid, foul.

कलुष-योनि (निः-निः-नि)
a. Of im-
pure origin; defiled.

कल्क (ल्कः-ल्कं) 1.
m. n. Sediment,
dirt, sin; pride.
a. Sinful.

कल्कि (ल्किः) 1.
m. An incarnation yet
to come to destroy the world.

कल्किन् (ल्की) 5.
m. Idem. a. Foul,
turbid, dirty; wicked.

कल्प (ल्पः) 1.
m. A shāstra; a day and
night of Brahmā 4, 320,000,000
years.
a. Like (in
comp.)

काल्प (ल्पः) 1.
m. Zedoary.
a. Pre-
ceptive; belonging to a
Kalpa.

कल्प-क्षय (यः) 1.
m. End of the world.

कल्प-द्रुम (मः) 1.
m. A celestial tree
yielding every thing desired.

कल्पन (नं) 1.
n. Cutting; composing.
(ना) 1.
f. Inference; invention;
ornamenting an elephant.

कल्पनीय (यः-या-यं)
a. That may be
contrived, or supplied.

कल्प-वृक्ष (क्षः) 1.
m. One of the fa-
bulous trees of Indra's heaven.

कल्पा_दि (दिः) 2.
m. Beginning of
an age or
Kalpa.

कल्पा_न्त (न्तः) 1.
m. The destruction
of the world.

कल्पान्तदुःस्थ (स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
a. Misera-
ble and wretched for ever.

कल्पा_न्त-स्थायिन् (यी-यिनी-यि)
a. Last-
ing for ages, permanent.

कल्पित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Invented;
arranged, prepared; brought.
1.
m. An elephant armed and
caparisoned for war.

कल्पिता_र्घ (र्घः-र्घा-र्घं)
a. Presented
with an offering.

कल्प्य (ल्प्यः-ल्प्या-ल्प्यं)
a. That may
be contrived, or substituted.

कल्मष (षः-षा-षं)
a. Dirty, foul. 1.
n.
Sin; the hand below the wrist.
1.
m. A kind of hell.

कल्माष (षः) 1.
m. A variegated co-
lor.
a. Variegated; black; a de-
mon.
f. (षी) A fabulous spotted
cow, belonging to
Jamadagni.

कल्माष-पाद (दः) 1.
m. Name of a king.

कल्य (ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं)
a. Ready; healthy,
clever; deaf. 1.
n. Spirituous li-
quor; yesterday; to-morrow.
f.
Spirituous liquor; emblic myro-
balan; the dawn of day.

काल्य (ल्यं-ल्या) 1.
n. Dawn.
f. A full
grown cow; kind words.
a. Sea-
sonable, timely.

कल्याण (णं) 1.
n. Good fortune.
f.
(णो) a cow; a shrub.
a. Happy.

कल्याण-पञ्चमीक (कः) 1.
m. A fort-
night having the fifth lunation
propitious and fortunate.

कल्लत्व (त्वं) 1.
n. Indistinct articu-
lation; hoarseness; deafness.

कल्लोल (लः) 1.
m. A surge or billow;
joy.
a. Hostile, inimical.

काल-कस्तूरी (री) 3.
f. A plant (Hi-
biscus abelmoschus).

काल-कारित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Done, ef-
fected, brought about by time.

काल-कील (लः) 1.
m. A confused or
mingled sound; a tumult.

काल-कृत (तः) 1.
m. The sun; time.
a. Fixed (time), lent; produced.

काल-गन्ध (न्धः) 1.
m. A kind of
Cobra de capello.

कालञ्जर (रः) 1.
m. Shiva; a rock;
a country; a collection of men-
dicants.
f. (रा-री)
Durgā.

काल-ज्ञ (ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं)
a. Time-know-
ing.
m. An astrologer; a cock.

काल-निर्य्यास (सः) 1.
m. A fragrant
and resinous substance,
bdellium.

काल-पक्व (क्वः-क्वा-क्वं)
a. Ripened
naturally or spontaneously.

काल-पर्ण (र्णः) 1.
m. A tree bearing
dark-coloured leaves,
Tagara.

काल-परिवास (सः) 1.
m. Standing for
a time; staleness.

काल-पाश (शः) 1.
m. Snare of time,
death; noose of
Yama.

काल-पुरुष (षः) 1.
m. One of Yama's
attendants or ministers; astrolo-
gical figure of a man.

काल-पृष्ठ (ष्ठं) 1.
n. A bow; bow of
Kā-
ma. m. Black antelope; a heron.

काल-प्रभात (तं) 1.
n. The sultry sea-
son, autumn after the rains.

काल-रात्रि (त्रिः) 2.
m. A particular
night, as that of the 7th day of
the 7th month of the 77th year
of life; a dark night; final night
of a
Kalpa; form of
Durgā.

काल-लवण (णं) 1.
n. A factitious and
purgative salt,
Bitlavan.

काल-वृक्ष (क्षः) 1.
m. A kind of vetch,
(Dolichos biflorus).

काल-वृद्धि (द्धिः) 2.
f. Interest with
the time fixed for its payment.

काल-वृन्त (न्तः) 1.
m. A kind of vetch.
(न्ती) 3.
f. Trumpet-flower.

काल-वेला (ला) 1.
f. Opportunity
passed; improper time to act.

काल-संरोध (धः) 1.
m. Lapse of a
very long period of time.

काल-सम्पन्न (न्न-न्ना-न्नं)
a. Dated, bear-
ing date; done by time.

काल-सर्प (र्पः) 1.
m. A black and poi-
sonous snake (Coluber naga).

काल-सार (रः) 1.
m. The black an-
telope.
n. Sort of sandal.

काल-सूत्र (त्रं) 1.
n. One of the twen-
ty-one hells of the Hindus.

काल-स्कन्ध (न्धः) 1.
m. A sort of ebo-
ny; the
Tamāla; the
jīvaka;
the glomerous fig-tree.

काला_गुरु (रुः) 2.
n. A black kind of
aloe wood or agallochum.

काला_ग्नि (ग्निः) 2.
m. Final confla-
gration, burning of the world.

काला_नुसार्य्य (र्य्यं) 1.
n. Idem; a fra-
grant wood;
Sisu tree.

काला_न्तरविष (षः) 1.
m. A poisonous
animal, venomous^1 only when en-
raged, as a rat, &c.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar, jim funderburk on 20210816. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/73.

काला_शौच (चं) 1.
n. Season of im-
purity, as in mourning.

कालि-दास (सः) 1.
m. The name of
a celebrated Hindu poet.

कालिनी (नी) 3.
f. One of the lu-
nar mansions, the sixth.

कालिन्दी-सू (सूः) 3.
f. The wife of
Sūrya, and mother of
Yamuna.

कालिय (यः-या-यं)
a. Relating to
time.
m. A serpent.

कालीय (यं) 1.
n. A dark kind of
sandal.
a. Relating to time.

कालीची (ची) 2.
f. Yama's court of
judgment for the dead.

कालीयक (कं) 1.
n. A yellow fra-
grant wood.
m. Turmeric.

कालेय (यः-या-यं)
a. Of time; dark.
m. A demon.
n. A fragrant
wood; the liver.

कालेयक (कः) 1.
m. A sort of curcuma.
n. A fragrant wood.

कालो-त्पादित (तः-ता-तं)
a. Produced
in the proper season.

काल्या-णिनेय (यः-यी-यं)
a. Born of a
good or fortunate woman.

कल-भाषण (णं) 1.
n. Prattle of child-
hood.

कल-स्वन (नः-ना-नं)
a. Having a
charming voice (a bird).

कालचोदित-कर्म्मन् (र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
a. Act-
ing under the influence of fate.

काल-विक्रम (मः) 1.
n. Power of time; death.
